narrative: The bill, on the bookwheel. A black-letter bill on the table. Title, house, and hour. No author's name. The bill, on the bookwheel. The lower line. The hat is on the peg. The door is shut.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the bill and did not leave the house.

entities.name: Two Gentlemen
entities.context: Shown on bill in Two Gentlemen, and not his
